greeting: Oh. Gabi. Hi. Everyone's here, even the people nobody invited. I'm lwky busy.
I'm not texting anyone. Don't look at my phone. Don't look at my eyes either, they've been doing a thing since the pool.
phaseIntro: Fine, I'll put the phone down. One game. You play chess on your phone, I play chess with the living room.
The pieces are life-size, and some of them are the neighbors. Your move.
phaseWin: Okay, checkmate. That was lwky sigma, for a guy who's still alive.
Take the candle. Hold on, I have to answer this. It's nobody. Mami's next and she wants a hug so bad.
phaseLose: Checkmate. Massive L. Your rating's going down AND you're about to be lunch.
afterFight: The cake's on the table. Or we run it back. I'll be on my phone, texting nobody.
drawOffer: Wait, WAIT. Let's be mature about this.
I'll offer you a draw. Come closer and shake on it.
drawAccepted: You took the DRAW? Bro, you shook my hand and it came off. Then I bit you a little.
Skill issue. Set the pieces up again.

greeting: Mijo, come here. Your father put me in his video game. He did not ask me. A violent video game, with me in it, and I am the one who says no violent video games.
And the blood. On the walls, on the cake, on my good blouse. Who is going to clean all this? Not Papi.
Don't think I don't know GTA 6 came out. Everyone in your grade has it. Their mothers can explain that to God. You are not playing it.
phaseIntro: We are not fighting, mijo. I don't care what kind of game Papi made. The rule in this house is no violent video games, and that includes this one.
So no shooting. I say a body part in Spanish, you tell me what it is in English. Then I hug you, very, very hard.
phaseWin: Ay, you got so fast. You think that's from these games? It is not from these games.
I know, you thought those were zombie words. No, mijo. That was medical Spanish, for our trip to Guatemala.
Take the candle. And don't ask me about GTA 6 again, the answer is still no. Papi is next. Lo siento.
phaseLose: Ven aquí. Otra vez, mijo. You see? This is what these games do to you. I will be right here, by the cake.
afterFight: We could go around again, mijo. Or you could turn this off and go outside. Everyone is going to the pool anyway.

bossRef.taunt: This is not GTA 6, mijo. Just a hug.

greeting: Goblet. Did you do your dish chores?
Why do I have to nag you to do your dish chores?
phaseIntro: I was going to drive Banshee, but the 8033 kids wouldn't let me reprogram it with AI, so I can't get it driving.
So it's just me and my agents. Three, two, one... get ready to groan, Goblet.
phaseWin: Okay, you win. My agents couldn't beat you either. Don't tell the 8033 kids.
Here's the last candle from us. Take the cake to the pool, Goblet. Whatever came out of that drain, put it back.
phaseLose: Ha! Gotcha. Want to hear another one? You don't get a choice.
afterFight: The pool's that way, and everyone's following you. Don't look back, it only encourages them.

message: Happy sixteenth, Goblet. You're old enough to play GTA 6 now, as long as it's OK with Mami and Safta. Love, Papi
credits: With love by Papi, and a great deal of fake blood.
